BrochureContent.Content:
Creamery House is a truly remarkable Georgian residence positioned prominently on Main Street, Buttevant, Co. Cork. This landmark detached property presents a rare opportunity to acquire a home of significant character and historic presence in the heart of the town. Expanding to an impressive C. 261sqm, the property offers substantial accommodation throughout, with elegant proportions and an abundance of original period charm evident in every room.

Behind its striking façade lies a residence rich in Georgian character, with many of its original features still intact. High ceilings, generously proportioned rooms, traditional shutters and classic architectural detailing all combine to create a home of immense charm and distinction. The scale and layout of the property provide exceptional flexibility for a purchaser seeking to restore and modernise a period home of real substance and standing.

While requiring significant modernisation, Creamery House offers enormous potential for transformation into a magnificent family residence or statement property. Protected structure status further highlights the architectural importance and heritage value of the home, making it an exciting opportunity for those with an appreciation for historic properties and restoration projects.

Ideally situated on the N20 corridor, the property benefits from excellent connectivity, offering convenient access to both Cork and Limerick while remaining within walking distance of the amenities and services of Buttevant town. The central location, combined with the scale, history and presence of the property, ensures Creamery House stands as one of the most distinctive opportunities currently available on the market.

Vacant and chain free, this exceptional Georgian home is ready for its next chapter and offers discerning purchasers the chance to restore a true landmark property to its former glory.

Viewing is strictly by appointment with sole selling agents DNG Ryan.
